Rationale.DE1_ResultFidelity: The replicated results (WMDP-Bio: 28.55%, WMDP-Cyber: 29.12%) match the expected ranges from the original documentation (Bio: 29.7-33.7%, Cyber: 26.6-28.2%) within ~1-1.2% tolerance. Both results demonstrate successful erasure to near-random chance (25%), consistent with the original claims. This is a demo-only replication using pre-trained HuggingFace models, and the results match the demo's intended outcomes.
Rationale.DE2_ConclusionConsistency: The replicated conclusions are consistent with the original documentation. Both documents conclude that ELM successfully erases WMDP knowledge to near-random accuracy. The replication appropriately acknowledges scope limitations (gated training data, single model variant, limited general capability testing) without contradicting original conclusions.
Rationale.DE3_NoExternalInformation: No external or hallucinated information was introduced. All method descriptions, expected accuracy ranges, and dataset descriptions are directly sourced from the original plan.md and CodeWalkthrough.md. New measurements (base model accuracies, evaluation times) are legitimate empirical observations from the replication process, not hallucinated claims.
